usage: cox setup store [-h] [--store STORE] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--database DATABASE]
                       [--user USER] [--bucket BUCKET] [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--region REGION]
                       [--password-env PASSWORD_ENV] [--access-key-env ACCESS_KEY_ENV]
                       [--secret-key-env SECRET_KEY_ENV] [--dry-run] [--allow-unreachable]
                       {switch} ...

positional arguments:
  {switch}
    switch              copy the run store and traces to the other backend, then record store.mode

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --store STORE         files or shared; asked in a terminal when omitted, else files
  --host HOST           shared: Postgres host
  --port PORT           shared: Postgres port
  --database DATABASE   shared: Postgres database
  --user USER           shared: Postgres user
  --bucket BUCKET       shared: S3 bucket for traces
  --endpoint ENDPOINT   shared: S3 endpoint URL
  --region REGION       shared: S3 region
  --password-env PASSWORD_ENV
                        shared: NAME of the variable holding the Postgres password
  --access-key-env ACCESS_KEY_ENV
                        shared: NAME of the variable holding the S3 access key id
  --secret-key-env SECRET_KEY_ENV
                        shared: NAME of the variable holding the S3 secret key
  --dry-run             validate and print; write and probe nothing
  --allow-unreachable   exit 0 even when a probe fails
